note: Total (and soluble, where given) oxalate measured by Siener and colleagues (University of Bonn, HPLC-enzyme-reactor method). Values with soluble oxalate come from the open-access Siener, Seidler & Hönow 2021 'Oxalate-rich foods' (Food Sci Technol, CC BY; Tables 1-2, read in full). The paywalled Siener 2006 Food Chem (Polygonaceae/Amaranthaceae/Chenopodiaceae) and 2006 J Agric Food Chem (cereals) papers and the 2017 beverages paper were not readable; their values here are as quoted in Siener's open-access review 'Nutrition and Kidney Stone Disease' (Nutrients 2021, PMC8229448, Tables 2-3), whose reference list identifies the original paper, plus one value stated in the cereals abstract. Legume/grain values are per 100 g of DRY uncooked seed as sold (serving sizes given here are therefore dry-weight portions from USDA FDC SR Legacy, 1/4 of the USDA 1-cup weight). Beverage values are mg/100 mL as reported. Hönow & Hesse 2002 values in the review were left to another helper. The single Siener row already in the Norton errata (Bread, wholemeal toast 40 mg) was not repeated.
